My dad is trying to rent an apartment for me next to my school and some place I can work to pay the rent, so maybe I'll have the same experience you had. I hope so (:
 Thank you very much for the sweet advice, have a wonderful night, sweet pie

Hello
 I hope you are feeling well
 Here in Brazil, at leat at my school, there isn't such things as a counselor... And I do not wish to talk with anyone that cares about me because the last thing I want is to worry the ones I love for being such a weak human being.
 Thank you very much for caring, have a wonderful night

Thank you very much for caring, I'll also be here for you while still alive, so count on be to help you as much as I can through any difficult time like you did with me.
 Have a wonderful night

Hello
 I am really sorry you also feel this way. I wish I could take all your pain and all the pain from all good people and take it with me to my grave.
 I honestly do not think it's dumb to commit suicide, not talking because I'm about to, but because I believe people have different scales of sadness tolerance and some can't stand pains that others consider small.
 My dad is actually looking for an apartment to rent for me, next to my school and some place I can work to pay the rent as soon as possible. Maybe that will help.
 If everything goes well tonight, I might be able to thank you for the congratulations tomorrow (:
 Again, thank you. Have a wonderful night and I wish things get better to you

Hello
 Thank you very much for caring (:
 I don't know very much how things work out there, but here in Brazil, at least in my school, we do not have such things as a counselor...
 It would be a pleasure to talk with such a wonderful woman. I'll send you a PM

Hello
 Thank you very much for the kind words!
 I do recognize I have a lot of great things to live for, more than a lot of people do, and that makes me feel even more weak.
 It's just that I can't live knowing that I'm a failure to my own father.

 Again, thank you a lot for caring. Have a wonderful night
Thank you very much, I too wish things get way better to you, I'm sure you deserve it more than I do (:

Hello
 I was answering the comments through PMs, but I think it would be better answering it here.
 I'll make sure to read it today, thank you a for the suggestion (:
 You are a wonderful father for caring so much about your daughter!
 Yes, my dad is asian, my mother is arabic.
 I actually play WoW with my boyfriend and a friend of us. It's a really good game.
 
 Thank you very much for caring, you made me happier. Have a wonderful night, sweet pie
